# MD View 1.0.0-rc.7

The seventh public release candidate of MD View: a native Markdown, text, and code editor for
Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Rust and egui. No webview.

## Highlights

- **Horizontal scrollbar only when needed.** The editor no longer shows a horizontal scrollbar
  under short lines. It appears only when a line is wider than the view, and never with soft
  wrap. The text area also no longer overflows sideways by the width of the vertical scrollbar.

Everything from the earlier candidates is included:

- **More file types (rc.6).** Editable spreadsheet grid for CSV/TSV, PDF and video viewers,
  animated GIF/WebP/APNG, more image formats including JPEG XL, richer animated SVG, and
  whole-fraction hover in the formula editor.
- **Equation gallery and formula editor (rc.5).** Σ gallery, √x editor with live preview,
  template palette, source-to-formula hover, and double-click editing.
- **System clipboard (rc.4)** and **editor behavior and the Markdown formatting bar (rc.3).**
- **From the earlier candidates:** split view with exact sync, GitHub Markdown parity, Oniguruma
  highlighting, CJK text, large files, the explorer that follows tabs, and the desktop packages.

## Install

Download the asset for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`:

| Platform | Preferred asset |
|---|---|
| Linux | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.7-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `mdview_1.0.0.rc.7_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora / RPM | `mdview-1.0.0.rc.7-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.7-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.7-windows-x86_64.msi` |

Video playback needs FFmpeg installed (`ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`, and `ffplay` for sound); everything
else is built in. The macOS and Windows RC builds are **unsigned**. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen may
ask for an extra confirmation. Signing and notarization remain final 1.0.0 release-operator steps.

Documentation: https://jigonzalez930209.github.io/md-view-rs/

## Checksums and SBOM

The release includes a combined `SHA256SUMS`, `latest.json`, and `sbom.cdx.json`. Use
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` on Linux/macOS or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.

Full changelog: https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/md-view-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
